faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NFDC Executive Assistant (P&A) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NFDC Executive Assistant (P&A) post is 24th August 2026. Ensure you complete your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Executive Assistant (P&A) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold any Graduation degree along with an MBA, PG Diploma, or Diploma in Human Resources to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Executive Assistant (P&A) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Executive Assistant (P&A) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month, which is inclusive of all allowances.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Executive Assistant (P&A) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Executive Assistant (P&A) position announced by the National Film Development Corporation.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Executive Assistant (P&A) is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the NFDC located?
faq.answer: The National Film Development Corporation is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this contractual recruitment is ADV-65/Contractual/14/08/2026.
